chapter: Russell and Armstrong years, Goodman and the road
title: First trip to Europe with Lucky Millinder
summary: He first went to Europe by ship with Millinder in the early 1930s.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When did you first go to Europe?
First time I went with Lucky Millinder. Yeah, we went over on a ship.
Do you know what year that was?
No... it was in the 30's, something like that.
Early 30's. I'm not sure. You're always going to find good ones and bad ones every place you go. Right here in New York.
